scope: Full five-organization local training; TRAIN and VAL only

dataset.root_policy: All observable recent User roots; covers every eligible fixed-grid target and retains ambiguous masks. Older context-only roots need no supervised forward pass, but remain available as sampled context.
dataset.cache: Immutable sampled input batches on disk, using accepted sampler seed and fanouts unchanged across epochs; cache roots are selected by observable recent activity, not labels
dataset.ordering: Chronological anchor, then variant identifier, then scoring grid, then deterministic local User order; alternative branches never share synthetic graph state

model.head: One binary logit per User root; linear head after two hidden GraphSAGE layers
model.initialization: Fresh seeded PyTorch/PyG initialization for every independent local trial; no imported/global/pretrained weights

training.class_weight: TRAIN eligible negative count / TRAIN eligible positive count; used only in training BCEWithLogitsLoss

selection.primary: Average precision (noninterpolated precision-recall area with tied scores grouped)
selection.epoch_tie: Earlier epoch retained unless AP exceeds min_ap_improvement
selection.candidate_tie: Greater VAL AP, then lower unweighted VAL BCE, then lexicographic candidate ID

metrics.loss: Weighted TRAIN BCE and unweighted VAL BCE; aggregate over eligible examples
metrics.diagnostics: Precision, recall and F1 at the fixed nominal 0.5 probability only; not calibrated alert thresholds or fixed-FPR results
metrics.test: No TEST files opened or scores produced

inductivity.unseen_user: Local User absent from the union of all TRAIN graph views
inductivity.unseen_ip: User's sampled root neighborhood includes an IP absent from all TRAIN graph views
inductivity.report: VAL subgroup metrics and counts; IP nodes remain context, not classification targets

reproducibility.repeat: Repeat full selected-hyperparameter training/early stopping for each organization with identical initialization seed and cached inputs; verify exact selected state digest and VAL scores
reproducibility.variation: Campaign seeds are dataset variation, not initialization repeats; exact replay does not measure initialization uncertainty

limitations: Repeated backgrounds and three temporal blocks per split remain dependent. No model-performance claim is inferred from successful software tests. Protocol and acceptance evidence are immutable; final TEST evaluation still requires the frozen protocol in version control.
